evidence_boundaries: KEMPIC-3D uses standard electromagnetic PIC algorithms; its representative LWFA run is quasi-two-dimensional, short, injection-free, and the promised source repository is not yet identified in the manuscript.

The LAPD paper directly measures nonlinear magnetic modes and smaller-scale structure, while the finite-k_perp-d_i mechanism also relies on Hall-MHD scaling and author hybrid-PIC controls; fully developed turbulence is not demonstrated.

The EKR, equivariant neural, and learned Pade closures are validated on analytic linearized moment-hierarchy data for bump-on-tail and slab-ITG models, not on nonlinear kinetic turbulence or experiment.
No KEMPIC-3D, CAMELIA, Vlasov, neural-network, or fluid-closure calculation was rerun locally.
